implementation.contract: Current host terminal executes available Node.js with the discovered Skill-root .runtime/bin/ecom-cli.mjs

mappings.discovery: Current host resolves exact Skill directory and Node.js runtime; probe CLI version and capabilities
mappings.normalization: Preserve the complete structured result, including container metadata, instance and operation identity, HTTP status, platform JSON and errors; attach process exit status separately
mappings.permissions: Local execution; explicit selected-target maintenance authorization
mappings.limitations: Browser transport currently macOS only; host discovery evidence is separate
